review_basis:
Twelfth golden, a second sheet mined from the same real project as Run 35's own golden (`013_MO_T2523_01_Replace_Boilers_Phase_2_Building_29.pdf`), found the same way: reading the sheet's own real text for HHWS/HHWR callouts first, this time surfacing a much richer set (`1 1/2"`, `3/4"`, `1 1/4"`, `4"`, `6"`, and an explicitly-marked `8" HHWS/HHWR (NEW)` pair) on sheet M-130 ('PARTIAL MECHANICAL PLAN - AREA D', two stacked partial views D-1 and D-2). An initial attempt to trace the flagged `8" (NEW)` riser directly near its own label did not land on it (the label sits some distance from the actual pipe on this sheet, a real search-radius miss rather than a missing candidate) -- widening the search around the SAME general area instead found a real, clean 6-inch HHWS/HHWR pair with genuine automatic binds.

Confirmed via two marked render crops: the `ambiguous` end (top) sits exactly on a real elbow/tee where a smaller 4" HHWR/HHWS branch ties into this run's own 6" main -- a real fork, not a misread, the same category Runs 34-35 already established as a legitimate scope boundary. The `dead_end` end (bottom) sits exactly on a real drawn break-line symbol with the sheet's own printed 'REFER TO M-131 SHEET FOR CONTINUATION' leader pointing directly at it -- the same cross-sheet-continuation convention Run 35's own M-122 golden already used, this time pointing to a DIFFERENT sheet (M-131, not M-121) since this is a different riser elsewhere in the same building. Both runs' own bench-style reseed was independently re-verified live and reproduces each result identically. The larger `8" (NEW)` riser flagged by the initial text search remains a real, disclosed, not-yet-located candidate on this same sheet -- worth a future, more careful visual search rather than further blind-radius guessing.
scope: Two real 6-inch heating hot water pipe runs (a matched HHWS/HHWR supply/return pair, ~27-28 LF each) on the same Missouri National Guard boiler-replacement project's own Partial Mechanical Plan - Area D, sheet M-130 (the lower 'Area D-2' view), each from a real branch tee (where a smaller 4" HHWR/HHWS run ties in) to a real cross-sheet continuation break-line (referring to sheet M-131). Explicitly OUT OF SCOPE: the 4" HHWR/HHWS branch itself past the tee; the continuation of both 6" pipes onto sheet M-131; the larger 8" HHWS/HHWR (NEW) riser this sheet's own text also flags, not yet precisely located; every other run on this real 28-sheet plan set (only sheet 12/M-130 sampled, in addition to Run 35's own sheet 11/M-122).
